limitations: Single A-then-B repetition, 8 sync samples per scene. Reverse-order/longer repeated and physical hardware results are not in this review. Small differences are not established causal gains.
With n=8 p95 and p99 both equal the maximum sample. FPS/1% Low are unmeasured; do not pool 64 different-scene samples into a tail metric.
Headless Linux x64 Chromium153/Playwright1.64.1/SwiftShader. Physical GPU, phones/tablets, power and thermals are unmeasured.
High/scale1/DPR1/640x360/Lite=false match, but other resolutions and mobile presets are separate conditions.
The note scheduler is disabled and UI/camera/stage/clock are controlled. No live audio quality, seat UI, multiplayer, loading or long-run validation is implied.
Only 12 original served source paths were hashed before/after. The 49-path manifest matches Git objects but is not HTTP coverage for every path, including CSS/index/geometry/instance-batches.
Whole-frame counters have no per-draw attribution. Static explanations of triangles/calls are inferences, not isolated experiments.
Six final PNG pairs are byte-identical; two differ. These eight final captures do not cover every animated frame or higher resolution.
Auxiliary camera pose, last render tick and canvas-font readiness are not separately recorded; cannot prove a stale feed/font or the correct cause of caption-region differences.
performance.memory is lower while all eight CDP after-heap readings are higher. API accounting/snapshot/GC differs; no total-memory/VRAM or leak conclusion.
TaskDuration can include sync waits/QA; phase times overlap and zero may reflect clock precision. Front ScriptDuration/ThreadTime and some submit times increase; CPU improvement is not uniform.
Timer extension existence is not a GPU-time measurement. GPU ms/VRAM, initial loading, hardware audio glitches and A/V synchronization remain unmeasured.
